description: Combine the 256-thread padded n=4096 global-best stack with the profile-driven 35 KiB n=1024 workspace winner. Import only n=1024 LD68/LD72 operand aliasing, later-live diagonal reuse, 100% shared carveout, and associated panel operators while preserving the many-CTA solve grids, n=4096 graph-replayed split factor/solve, compact n=512, aliased n=2048, every other dispatch, caller-stream semantics, caches, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Integrated the second parent's exact profile-driven batch60/n1024 workspace into the 256-thread padded batch2/n4096 first parent: retained LD68 FP32/LD72 FP16 operands and the 720/480/240 many-CTA solve grids, aliased the update operands with the later-live diagonal tile to cut panel dynamic shared memory from the hosted capture's 53.25 KiB one-block limit to 35 KiB, and requested 100% shared carveout. The first parent's four 64-wide n4096 micro-panels, 256-thread factor/solve launches, 128 solve CTAs, fifteen CuTe updates, graph replay, and all other paths remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 972.964 us versus 1033.804 on its common-parent source, while batch2/n4096 measured 1870.476 us versus first-parent 1848.446 amid sampling noise; aggregate measured 805.636 us versus first-parent 801.115.

Applied the exact integrated index7 profile's 96-register occupancy limit by reducing only the aliased LD68/LD72 n1024 panel from 256 to 192 threads and predicating the final cooperative load row, aiming for three resident CTAs while preserving 720/480/240 grids, 35 KiB workspace, full carveout, the n4096 graph path, and all other dispatches. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch60/n1024 regressed from 972.964 to 2689.804 us and aggregate from 805.636 to 857.622; the 256-thread MathDx/operator configuration remains the lower measured integrated source. No additional hosted request was launched.

Restored the exact profiled 256-thread LD68/LD72 aliased workspace, then capped only the n1024 panel kernel at 80 registers/thread, the highest conservative allocation multiple below the three-CTA residency threshold implied by the exact capture's 96-register two-block limit. The 35.84 KiB shared workspace, 100% carveout, 720/480/240 grids, first-parent n4096 graph implementation, and every other path remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 improved from 972.964 to 943.521 us; batch2/n4096 measured 1854.437 us, and aggregate improved from 805.636 to a new brief/global low 796.862 us versus the 801.115 first parent. No second hosted request was launched.

Raised only the profiled aliased n1024 panel register cap from 80 to 84, testing the upper edge of three-CTA residency while holding the exact 256-thread source, LD68/LD72 workspace, full carveout, grids, n4096 graph path, and every other dispatch fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 regressed from 943.521 to 1038.970 us, consistent with crossing an allocation-granularity residency threshold; aggregate measured 814.293 in a broadly slower fleet sample versus 796.862 at cap80. The 80-register cap remains the lower measured integrated source. No hosted request was launched.

Lowered only the exact integrated 256-thread n1024 panel register cap from 84 to 64, testing four-CTA theoretical residency against additional spill pressure while preserving the 35.84 KiB alias, full carveout, 720/480/240 grids, n4096 graph implementation, and all other dispatches. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 952.166 us versus 943.521 at cap80 and 1038.970 at cap84; aggregate measured 805.874 amid unrelated-cell variance. The 80-register three-CTA threshold remains the lower measured target and aggregate. No hosted request was launched.

Restored byte-identical cap80 source after the completed 64/80/84 sweep (verified against succeeded commit 68a982e), and the slice build passed. The slice-wrapped Modal validation then remained stalled after container startup with no test output for 1008 seconds, more than 11x the environment's 90-second allowance, and was terminated; no benchmark was launched and no additional hosted profile request was issued. Identical source at 68a982e already passed all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid at 796.862 us, so that succeeded commit remains the measured handoff.

Combined the 256-thread padded n4096 parent with the exact profile-driven 35 KiB n1024 workspace and ran six committed trials. Trial0 ddc7796 imported only LD68/LD72 workspace aliasing, later-live diagonal reuse, and 100% carveout; all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed, reaching 805.636 us aggregate and 972.964 us at batch60/n1024 while preserving the first parent's n4096 graph path byte-for-byte. The single authorized hosted index7 request ran on exact ddc7796 at 2026-07-20T01:13:06Z as job ead1f4ccabc848549f5cfc15ee49e3d7 and succeeded; canonical brief-65-trial-0-ddc7796a810e8fcdae79d37886adaf722c36fb31 artifacts show the panel falling from the second parent's 270.24 us, 53.25 KiB, 12.47% occupancy, and 62.03% no-eligible to 218.94 us, 35.84 KiB, 22.70% occupancy, and 51.90% no-eligible, with 96 registers/thread still limiting residency. The first parent's hosted n4096 capture remained the integration constraint: 24.16 us factor and 23.39 us solve at 49.16 KiB, 96/168 registers, about 6.2% occupancy, and 82% no-eligible. Profile-guided Trial1's 192-thread panel regressed n1024 to 2689.804 us. Trial2 68a982e capped only the restored 256-thread panel at 80 registers; every check passed, n1024 improved to 943.521 us, n4096 measured 1854.437 us, and aggregate reached a new brief/global low 796.862 us versus the 801.115 parent. Cap84 measured 1038.970/814.293 and cap64 measured 952.166/805.874, bracketing cap80 as the lower target and aggregate. Final eb71fbd restores source byte-identical to 68a982e, but its redundant validation stalled remotely after startup for 1008 seconds and is logged runtime_error; use succeeded commit 68a982e as the measured handoff. Exactly one hosted request was issued. Keep the work moving: a future authorized capture of cap80 can verify achieved register count, spill traffic, and three-CTA residency; source-level live-range reduction without forced spilling, stage-specific register caps/operators for the 720/480/240 grids, and residency-aware 128-block tail scheduling remain concrete openings.
